safetyNotice.english: Use this for basic communication support only. Emergency symptoms, consent, diagnosis, and treatment decisions require a clinician and a qualified human interpreter.
safetyNotice.tamil: இது அடிப்படை தொடர்புக்கு மட்டும். அவசர அறிகுறிகள், சம்மதம், நோயறிதல், சிகிச்சை முடிவுகள் மருத்துவர் மற்றும் தகுதியான மொழிபெயர்ப்பாளர் மூலம் உறுதிப்படுத்தப்பட வேண்டும்.
safetyNotice.telugu: ఇది ప్రాథమిక సంభాషణకు మాత్రమే. అత్యవసర లక్షణాలు, సమ్మతి, నిర్ధారణ మరియు చికిత్స నిర్ణయాలకు వైద్యుడు మరియు అర్హత కలిగిన మానవ అనువాదకుడు అవసరం.

fallback.english: I need a human interpreter or nurse to understand this safely.
fallback.tamil: இதைக் பாதுகாப்பாகப் புரிந்துகொள்ள எனக்கு மனித மொழிபெயர்ப்பாளர் அல்லது செவிலியர் தேவை.
fallback.telugu: దీనిని సురక్షితంగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి నాకు మానవ అనువాదకుడు లేదా నర్స్ అవసరం.

phrases.clinicalNote: Ask pain score, duration, vomiting, fever, pregnancy status when relevant.
Check severity, vision changes, weakness, injury, fever, and blood pressure.
Measure temperature and ask duration, chills, cough, travel, and medicines taken.

phrases.english: I have chest pain. Please call a doctor immediately.
phrases.tamil: எனக்கு மார்பு வலி உள்ளது. தயவுசெய்து உடனே மருத்துவரை அழைக்கவும்.
phrases.telugu: నాకు ఛాతి నొప్పి ఉంది. దయచేసి వెంటనే డాక్టర్ను పిలవండి.
phrases.clinicalNote: Treat as urgent until assessed. Notify clinician immediately.

phrases.english: I am having difficulty breathing. Please help immediately.
phrases.tamil: எனக்கு மூச்சு விட சிரமமாக உள்ளது. தயவுசெய்து உடனே உதவுங்கள்.
phrases.telugu: నాకు శ్వాస తీసుకోవడం కష్టంగా ఉంది. దయచేసి వెంటనే సహాయం చేయండి.
phrases.clinicalNote: Escalate immediately and check oxygen saturation per hospital protocol.

phrases.english: I need to see a doctor.
phrases.clinicalNote: Confirm department, urgency, and registration status.
Route to nurse station or ward staff.

phrases.english: I am allergic to this medicine.
phrases.clinicalNote: Stop non-emergency administration until allergy is verified by clinical staff.

phrases.english: When should I take my medicine?
phrases.clinicalNote: Medication instructions must be confirmed by nurse, doctor, or pharmacist.
Check nil-by-mouth or procedure restrictions before giving water.
Offer mobility help if the patient is weak, dizzy, or post-procedure.
Prevent falls and notify staff for vitals assessment.
